GeneRoleClassifier — Multi-Scale 1D-CNN Training, Optuna Tuning & Validation

Curating non-redundant bacterial reference proteins across UniProtKB (Pfam/InterPro), UniRef50, NCBI IPG, and KEGG Orthology, deduplicating via [Clusterer][serogen.core.seq.clustering.Clusterer] (80% CD-HIT), and training [GeneRoleClassifier][serogen.genes.cnn.GeneRoleClassifier] across all 29 functional GeneRoles.

1. Non-Redundant Reference Curation & Protein Length Profiles

Post-clustering deficit top-up guarantees at least 30 non-redundant sequences (<= 80% identity) per functional GeneRole, while median-absolute-deviation (3.5 MAD) length filtering removes truncated fragments and polyprotein fusions.

2. Optuna TPE Hyperparameter Optimization & Layer Representation Sweep

Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) search over multi-scale motif kernel widths, filter capacity, embedding dimension, and AdamW regularization, followed by a Numba-parallel representation sweep across all layers (best=proba).
